Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, and converters operating globally to serve various industries such as pharmaceuticals, food, and biotechnology.

# Cold Chain Packaging Design, Engineering and Testing

Cryopak is a complete cold chain packaging solutions provider specializing in the field of
temperature-controlled packaging. From needs assessment to package qualification, Cryopak handles
your packaging projects with one paramount goal: Maintaining the integrity of your products. Our
materials and processes cover the spectrum from converting EPS or fabricating boxes to manufacturing
phase change materials and temperature monitors.

## Services

Cryopak offers a wide range of services to go along with our one-of-a-kind solutions. From testing
and qualification to recycling and reuse, we are a full-service company ready to provide you with
what you need.

* ### Helping the cannabis industry
  
  Prevent mold growth without drying out the cannabinoids and terpenes, and increase shelf life by
  transporting your products within the proper temperature and humidity ranges, with our
  specifically design pallet shippers and insulated boxes.
* ### Serving the Pharmaceutical Industry
  
  The pharmaceutical industry demands stringent monitoring of your payload’s temperature. Just one
  degree off can spoil products and cause financial losses. Don’t risk it. Let Cryopak provide you
  with accurate monitoring solutions.
* ### Providing Premium Retail Products
  
  Our Ice-Pak Brand is an integral part of any lunch box or cooler. From bottles and blankets to hot
  packs and coolers, we have the solution for your every need.
* ### Keeping Food & Beverage Cold
  
  There’s no use in crying over spoiled milk. With Cryopak´s temperature and humidity monitoring
  solutions, you can track the enviroment of your product in real-time.

### Who **We Are**

We create a positive impact for a better and healthier world through aggressive sustainability,
diversity, and inclusion initiatives.

thinking that deliver transformative business results to our clients.

## Why **choose** Chill-Pak™?

cold-chain packaging challenges to

## Protection and Distribution

When properly engineered, there is no substitute for quality in protective packaging. EFP offers a

solutions, and packaging supply chain services. Headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, EFP has locations

Carolina; and Casa Grande, Arizona providing coverage to the west coast and mid-America from Canada
to the Gulf of America. EFP is owned by J.B. Poindexter & Co., a privately held, diversified
manufacturing company with operating subsidiaries throughout North America. EFP is committed to
innovating current products, creating sustainable solutions, and providing services that support our

Yes! We offer Free Samples so you can test the quality, size, and durability yourself. You only need

We are start-up friendly. While MOQs vary by product (e.g., custom print vs. stock), we strive to

Absolutely. All our products, including Corn Starch, PP, and flexible pouches, are certified to meet
FDA and LFGB standards for food safety.

bag, we provide design support from concept to print.

waterproof, crush-resistant, and freezable. It's lighter than plastic crates but tougher than paper.

Tempack, by CSafe, is a **leading global provider in the isothermal and refrigerated packaging
sector.** Our primary activity focuses on the manufacture, development and qualification of
packaging solutions for transporting and distributing essential, temperature-sensitive goods, **with
a special focus on food products, which require a cold chain delivery**.

## Optimize your cold chain management for last-mile home delivery with Tempack

Tempack’s passive temperature-controlled solutions are specifically developed to support **food
last-mile delivery operations**, ensuring that chilled and frozen products maintain stability from
fulfilment preparation through to final distribution.
Our systems help retailers, e-grocery operators and logistics providers preserve product quality
while improving operational efficiency in urban delivery environments.

**Preservation of Freshness and Quality**

Our packaging maintains the precise temperature ranges required for chilled and frozen food
distribution, preventing spoilage and preserving product quality throughout last-mile delivery
routes.

**Guaranteed Cold Chain Integrity**

Designed specifically for last-mile deliveries, our packaging solutions maintain stable temperatures
even in varying external conditions, ensuring cold chain integrity from the distribution or
fulfilment centre to the customer.

**Reduced Spoilage and Waste**

By protecting chilled and frozen products during home delivery, our solutions minimize product loss,
reducing waste and supporting both sustainability efforts and cost savings for retailers.

**Compliance with Home Delivery Standards**

All packaging solutions are built to meet the necessary regulations and best practices for
transporting perishable goods, ensuring compliance and reducing the risk of product returns or
customer dissatisfaction upon delivery.

**Traceability and monitoring**

Our packaging solutions can integrate monitoring technologies to provide visibility across food
distribution routes, suporting quality assurance and operational control in last-mile
delivery.  Depending on operational needs, features may include temperature alerts, location
visibility and connectivity tools that help logistics teams maintain product integrity throughout
delivery.

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a

practices, reducing waste and energy consumption while delivering excellence in cold chain

At Allwin, we are a dynamic startup with a strong foundation in temperature-controlled packaging
solutions, supported by the expertise of our parent company, known for producing PUF insulated ice
boxes and shippers. We’re committed to ensuring the safe and reliable transport of
temperature-sensitive goods through innovative solutions designed to meet the demands of modern cold
chain needs.

commitments. With our skilled team, advanced technology, reliable processes, and specialized

# The Gate of Fresh Produce

with care, quality, and sustainability

[Contact us][18]

## **We create the perfect solution to all your horticultural needs in providing sustainably grown
## fruits, packed and exported directly to your market.**

### **Why Choose Avogate?**
* **Premium Quality:** Fresh produce that meets the highest global standards.
* **Sustainability First:** Eco-friendly operations that protect our planet.
* **Farmer Empowerment:** Creating lasting impact in rural communities.

## One-stop Solution for Precise Cold Chain Temperature Control and Monitoring

[Cold Chain Package Solutions]

### Cold Chain Package Solutions

● Multiple Cooling Modes : Passive, Evaporative and active refrigeration

● Regulatory Compliance : Prequalified According to  ISTA, WHO, GSP

● Precise Temperature Control : 2℃~8℃，-25℃~-15℃，+15℃~+25℃，-80℃~-20℃

● Strong Insulation : From 24 to 240 hours duration

● Multiple sizes and specifications : 0.5L - 2000L available.

Packaging][58]

● Available : -5℃ ,-12℃,-16℃,-18℃, -21℃,-25℃,-55℃, 5℃ ,10℃， 21℃,-55℃,+60℃

● Flexible Adaptation:Multi-forms,Ice gel pack, HDPE Plastic Ice Pack,Foam Ice Pack, No-sweating Ice
Pack， Fit All Needs.

● Safe and Eco-friendly:Non-toxic, Safe for Goods. Independent research, development and production

● Long-lasting Durability : Stable, Long Service Life.

[Customized Service ][59]
[Temperature monitoring platform]

### Temperature monitoring platform

● Visualization : Intuitive visual for trend analysis with Computer and Mobile

● Traceability : Historic Record keep more than 5 Years

● Accuracy : With High-Precison Temperature and Humidity Sensor

● Real-time : Monitoring with Cloud platform ，Instant Access

● Stability : with reliable 4G or Lora Data logger application in Millions

● Flexibility : Customizable for diverse cold chains.and Support Open API

[Validation and Calibration Service]

### Validation and Calibration Service

● Comprehensive Validation Scope  ：Cold Chain Package, Freezer，  Cold Warehouse, refrigerated
truck

● Regulatory :  Adherence to ISTA 3A, ISTA 7D, GSP, GDP,WHO Standard

● Visualization of  whole ：validation process with independent developed of validation devices

● Cost-Effective Approach : generated validation report with intelligent validation cloud platform

● Independent Validation: Laboratory with experienced Technical Team

[RFID Asset Management System]

### RFID Asset Management System

● Accurate Asset Traceability：Achieves pinpoint tracking of all cold chain assets, ensuring
seamless supply chain visibility and minimizing loss risks.

● Seamless Data Automation：Integrates terminals for effortless data capture and upload. Eradicates
manual errors, fueling informed decisions and streamlined management.

● Rigorous Process Oversight：Enforces SOPs for asset use. Manages ice pack and cooler box
lifecycles precisely, elevating operational quality and compliance.

● Swift Alert Intervention：Triggers instant alarms during transport glitches. Expedites issue
resolution, safeguarding goods integrity and averting losses.

● Tailored & Robust Security：Customizes permissions, suits diverse enterprises. Facilitates
multi-org use securely, aligning with varied business scales.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does CLEARFAST offer?

*CLEARFAST provides comprehensive logistics solutions including air and sea freight forwarding,
custom clearance, warehousing, transportation management, supply chain consultancy, and specialized
services for handling over-dimensional cargo, temperature-sensitive goods, and dangerous goods. Our
global network ensures your cargo reaches its destination efficiently and safely*

How does CLEARFAST ensure timely delivery of cargo?

*Our commitment to timely delivery is supported by an advanced transportation management system,
offering real-time tracking and reporting. Our strong relationships with major carriers and a 24/7
service for time-critical consignments allow us to provide reliable and expedient transport
solutions across our global network.*

Can CLEARFAST handle the logistics for specialized cargo?

*Yes, CLEARFAST has extensive experience in handling specialized cargo such as Over Dimensional
Cargo (ODC), project cargo, temperature-controlled shipments, and Dangerous Goods (DG). Our skilled
team offers tailored solutions, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and delivering your

# Packing & Logistics

technology and knowledgeable expertise ensuring our customers are getting the utmost efficiency and
dedication throughout their shipment life cycle.

## Our Partners

#### Cold Chain Packing – partners with world-class industry leaders to deliver quality temperature
#### controlled products and logistics solutions.

[elpro logo][elpro logo]

##### Cold Chain Packing are the Middle East distributors for ELPRO – providing connected central
##### monitoring solutions as well as independent monitoring systems for rooms and equipment, and
##### stability monitoring logging devices for products in transit

[Envirotainer logo][Envirotainer logo]

##### Envirotainer is the global market leader in secure cold chain solutions for the pharmaceutical
##### supply chain, with the worlds largest active container fleet. We offer leasing of innovative
##### container solutions, including validation, support & service, for products that require a
##### controlled environment.

[PELI BIOTHERMAL][PELI BIOTHERMAL]

##### We are the Middle East distributors for PELI BioThermal – a global leader in providing the
##### widest range of passive single-use and reusable temperature controlled thermally protected
##### packaging solutions, to the global life science industry.

[7pgps logo][7pgps logo]

##### Also representing as the Middle East distributors for 7P – providing Global Visual Management
##### to biopharma, high-value, high-theft risk cargoes and progressive industries and manufacturers
##### around the world who need to communicate with their assets or manage their supply chain

## Our Solutions

## [Cold Chain Logistics][17]

Our reputable brand is backed by 20 years of experience and devoted to excellence, providing global
logistics services by air, sea, and road for industry leading brands.

We have a Global presence through carefully selected & fully compliant partners, with proven
expertise and rigorous quality standards.

Providing a tailor made end-to-end service – flexible to our customer needs – whilst being capable
of demonstrating a speed of response and efficiency.

We have a unique understanding of both the logistics challenges presented by extreme local
environments, combined with the global compliance and regulatory frameworks that underpin the
logistics industry. This is backed up by our vast operational experience in providing time and
temperature sensitive supply chain solutions, and our holistic range of industry-leading products
and services.

We offer a white glove service for clinical trials, or send outs, whether its Direct-to-Patient
(DTP) or Direct-from-Patient Services (DFP)!

[Learn More][18]

## [Domestic Transportation][19]

Fully integrated with our other supply chain services, our tailor-made domestic road freight
solution ensures operational excellence as well as a cost-effective option. Each of our thermal
mapped temperature-controlled vans are fitted with a sophisticated tracking tool, allowing you to
track your cargo’s progress in real-time!

## [Cold Chain Logistics][17]

Our reputable brand is backed by 20 years of experience and devoted to excellence, providing global
logistics services by air, sea, and road for industry leading brands.

We have a Global presence through carefully selected & fully compliant partners, with proven

Providing a tailor made end-to-end service – flexible to our customer needs – whilst being capable

We have a unique understanding of both the logistics challenges presented by extreme local

## [Domestic Transportation][19]

Fully integrated with our other supply chain services, our tailor-made domestic road freight
solution ensures operational excellence as well as a cost-effective option. Each of our thermal
mapped temperature-controlled vans are fitted with a sophisticated tracking tool, allowing you to
track your cargo’s progress in real-time!

[Learn More][20]

## [Passive Packaging Solutions][21]

Cold Chain Packing® is the exclusive Middle East distributor for Peli BioThermal.

Pharmaceutical companies — and other organizations looking to make significant cost and quality
improvements in their cold chains — are switching to Peli BioThermal for single-use and reusable
temperature-controlled packaging.

Our innovative, patented technologies and consultative services ensure product quality, mitigate
excursion rates, reduce packaging costs and drive Total Cost of Ownership across your entire supply
chain.

[Learn More][22]

## [Temperature Monitoring & Mapping][23]

Our Monitoring systems and solutions for rooms, equipment, & products in transit, cover Critical
Control Points in your supply chain, whilst helping you to record and manage temperature and
humidity levels in storage areas and within your shipment during transportation, covering those
Critical Control Points in your supply chain.

We measure, record, and manage data and – based upon stability criteria – assess these data for
release or alarm.

[Learn More][24]

## [Live Monitoring & Tracking Solutions][25]

We provide Global Visual Management to biopharma, high-value, high-theft risk cargoes and
progressive industries and manufacturers around the world who need to communicate with their assets
or manage their supply chain.

Whether the assets are stationary remote power stations or biological products being shipped around
the world we have a solution leveraging the intelligence of our technology, proprietary software
applications, and our people.

[Learn More][26]

## Dedicated Pharma Team

Our Pharma Team has the experience and expertise to provide support with ensuring your goods travel
safely through some of the harshest environments on earth.

# Cold Chain Packaging

Apex Packaging is a leading distributor and manufacturer of cold chain packaging products. Our
products are ideal for temperature-sensitive packaging in food, chemical, and pharmaceutical
markets.

[Get a Quote][10]

## Apex’s cold chain packaging product line includes:
* Insulated shipping containers
* Temperature monitoring devices
* Insulated coolers
* Barrier reflective covers
* Polystyrene sheets

## Cold Chain Products

Apex Packaging cold chain products are used in hundreds of applications to maintain the temperature
within a specified range during shipment and transport. Benefits of cold chain packaging
include improved shelf life and preventing spoilage.

Let's Take Your Cold Chain Packaging to The Next Level

[Contact US][11]

### Fiber Pads

Easy to use fiber pads and gel packs with packing cardboard box.

[Kodiakooler.png]

Insulated foam materials keep your products within a specific temperature range during shipping and
transport.

[Cold-Chain-Custom-Cooler-2.png]

### Insulated Foam

### Cold Storage

A variety of cold storage solutions for your food-related products keep food fresher during shipment
and transport.

[Cheesecake-Custom-Packer-2.jpg]

### Temperature Devices

TurboTag DR-1 Desktop Reader
TurboTag Session Manager 
TurboTag T-700 series temperature monitoring tags 

[APEX-Turbo-Tage.png]

### Chemical

Prevent chemical contamination due to temperature fluctuations with our advanced temperature
controlled packaging

### Pharmaceutical

Temperature controlled packaging during storage and transportation of temperature sensitive
products. Ideal for cell and gene therapy and products that need to be kept at cold temperatures.

### Food

Large selection of cold chain packaging solutions to keep your food products fresh during
transportation and storage

  Who We Are

# Specialists in Temperature Controlled Logistics

Reliable cold chain solutions for food and pharmaceutical shipments across the UK, Europe, and
worldwide.

[Speak to an Expert][13]
[Get a Quote][14]

Welcome to Cool Cargo UK — your trusted specialist in cold chain logistics.


We provide temperature‑controlled transport solutions for chilled, frozen, and ambient goods,
ensuring your food and pharmaceutical shipments are delivered safely, compliantly, and on time.


With services by air, road, and sea, Cool Cargo supports UK‑to‑EU and global shipments with full
temperature control, live tracking, and expert handling.

### Our Cold Chain Services

#### Temperature Controlled Air Freight

[temperature-controlled air cargo]

Chilled and frozen air cargo solutions for urgent and time critical food and pharmaceutical
shipments.

#### Refrigerated Road Transport

[Refrigerated-Transport-uk-cool-cargo-EU (2).jpg]

UK and European chilled and frozen groupage and full load services with monitored temperature
control.

#### Reefer Sea Freight Shipping

[shipping services.jpg]

Cost effective refrigerated container shipping for frozen and chilled goods worldwide.

#### Pharmaceutical & Sample Couriers

[Pharmaceutical Transport UK.jpg]

Dedicated temperature controlled courier services for medicines, trials, and time sensitive samples.

across Australia.

## Brand & Design Innovation Consultancy

[See All Solutions][29]

As an interdisciplinary brand and design innovation consultancy, Creativeans bridges strategy,
creativity, business thinking, and technology to help organisations build brands that matter. We
believe that strong brands are not built through design alone, but through a deep understanding of
the business, its people, market opportunities, customer needs, and long-term growth ambitions.

Guided by our proprietary methodologies such as [**BrandBuilder^{®}**][30] and [**EDIT Design
Thinking^{®}**][31], we work across brand strategy, identity design, packaging, UI/UX,
communication, and experience design to create solutions that are both meaningful and actionable.
Our approach allows us to uncover insights, define clear brand directions, and translate strategy
into tangible touchpoints that connect with audiences across every stage of the brand journey.

Branding
1Branding

There’s a direct connection between a company’s brand and its success. A strong brand provides a
significant competitive advantage that differentiates it from its competitors.

As brand builders, we combine strategic and creative thinking to offer an integrated and holistic
approach to increase brand value. We help to audit and position your brand, express your brand
identity and eventually, execute your brand touch points. In other words, the whole nine yards. We
leave nothing to chance.

The success of a business’s brand goes hand in hand with continuous innovation. Through our
interdisciplinary use of analytical tools and creative processes, we help businesses uncover and
take advantage of untapped opportunities in the market and transform their business.

## Your trusted logistics partner for Dangerous Goods

With many years of experience in handling dangerous goods, in line with IATA Dangerous Goods
Regulations for air shipments and the IMDG Code for sea transport, DG Packaging ensures safe and
compliant transportation across all modes.

Our expertise assures that all hazardous materials are properly classified, packed, and documented.
This commitment provides our clients with reliable and secure dangerous goods logistics solutions.

[View our solutions][18] [Learn more][19]

#### Dangerous Goods Packaging
* UN Specification Packaging
* Hazmat Certified Transporation (SCDF)
* Compliant with IATA & IMDG Regulations

[What are considered dangerous goods?][20]

#### Temperature Sensitive Packing
* Reusable or Single-use, cost-effective insulated containers
* Validated Coolpac kits for 2°C to 8°C shipments
* Integration with DGP PATHOPAK products for diagnostic and infectious materials

#### Lithium Battery Solutions
* Fully compliant expert handling and packaging for safe lithium battery transportation according to

# Leader in Protective Packaging & Cold Chain Solutions


[Learn About EFP][22]
[Feature1]

### Protective Packaging

## Protection and Distribution

When properly engineered, there is no substitute for quality in protective packaging. EFP offers a
broad range of materials with physical properties that allow packaging designers to meet the many
challenges of protection and distribution. With the appropriate engineering design considerations,
EFP will provide you with truly cost-effective protective packaging.

[Explore][23]

[Feature2]

### Temperature Solutions

## Ideation to Conception

Consultation, design, and packaging design services are at your fingertips with EFP’s Temperature
Solutions Group. We offer a complete cold-chain product line from ideation to conception. Our
talented Center of Excellence Packaging Engineers has a firm commitment to problem-solving,
consistently producing excellent results for our customers.

[Explore][24]

[Gabriel Jimenez Jin4w1hqgl4 Unsplash 2]

### Sustainability

## The Future of Packaging is Circular

EFP is committed to taking a 360-degree approach to sustainability. We’re evolving the materials we
use, the takeback systems we create and the industry-driven partnerships we pursue to keep
sustainability in our line of sight and spark industry-wide lasting change.

[Explore][25]

# Decades of Premier Packaging Solutions

Founded in 1954, EFP, LLC is a leader in protective packaging, consumer packaging, cold chain
solutions, and packaging supply chain services. Headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, EFP has locations
in Evansville, Indiana; Howell, Michigan; La Vergne, Tennessee; Decatur, Alabama; Bishopville, South
Carolina; and Casa Grande, Arizona providing coverage to the west coast and mid-America from Canada
to the Gulf of America. EFP is owned by J.B. Poindexter & Co., a privately held, diversified
manufacturing company with operating subsidiaries throughout North America. EFP is committed to
innovating current products, creating sustainable solutions, and providing services that support our
corporate purpose of Protecting What Matters.

contributing to economic growth and showcasing the richness of Indian goods worldwide.

market.

temperature-sensitive commodities and alerts you whenever deviation is detected. This enables you to
make immediate decisions to minimize product loss and maintain product integrity.

* **Dinweys** offers a diverse range of cuts and sizes (Shoestring, Crinkle, Straight Cut) with
  **Grade A quality and guaranteed batch consistency.**
* We are dedicated to delivering the most suitable products and an **exceptional, worry-free service
  experience** to our global clients.

## Our Competitive Advantages
* **Unwavering Quality & Consistency:** Cutting-edge, fully automated production lines ensure
  premium, Grade A standards and reliable batch consistency for every shipment.
* **Stable Supply Chain:** Strategically located in China’s prime potato growing region,
  guaranteeing a year-round supply of high-quality raw materials.
* **Logistics Efficiency:** Only 300 km from Tianjin Port, significantly reducing transit times and
  lowering CIF transportation costs for global export.
* **Exceptional Price Competitiveness:** Highly automated, large-scale facilities combined with
  regional cost advantages ensure industry-leading pricing without compromising quality.
* **Dedicated Global Support:** Professional international sales and logistics teams provide 24/7
  comprehensive support, ensuring smooth communication and efficient order fulfillment.
* **Ease of Collaboration:** Just 200 km from Beijing, making factory audits, quality checks, and
  partnership meetings simple and convenient for international clients.

[China french fries factory]

## Frozen French Fries Production Process

The meticulous control over each stage ensures the superior quality and frying performance of
Dinweys’ frozen French fries. Our process is optimized for high dry matter retention, texture
consistency, and long-term stability.

### 1. Raw Material Selection: The Foundation of Quality

We begin with high-quality potatoes selected specifically for processing.

> **Key Advantage:** We exclusively use potato raw materials with a **dry matter content exceeding
> 22% (DM）> 22%)**. This crucial factor ensures a lower oil absorption rate and a crispier final
> texture.

### 2. High-Efficiency Cleaning & Peeling

Raw potatoes undergo thorough cleaning followed by a precise, hygienic peeling process.

> **Key Technique:** Peeling is performed using **high-temperature steam**, which minimizes surface
> damage and retains more of the potato’s valuable outer layer nutrients compared to mechanical
> abrasive methods.

### 3. Precision Cutting & Water Reduction

Potatoes are cut into uniform strips (e.g., standard 9mm or 12mm) using high-precision cutters.
Ripple-cut styles are also available.

> **Crucial Step (Dewatering):** Following blanching, we achieve a high **product dehydration rate
> of 25%–30%**. This optimized moisture removal is vital for minimizing oil absorption during frying
> and maximizing final crispiness.

### 4. Blanching & Color Protection

Strips are blanched at controlled temperatures (85–95°C) to remove excess starch and lock in color.

### 5. Pre-Frying (Par-Frying)

The fries are par-fried at approximately 160°C to develop the iconic golden color and form a
protective outer layer, enhancing flavor and crunch when cooked by the end-user.

### 6. Advanced Quick Freezing

Rapid freezing is critical for locking in flavor and texture.

> **Advanced Technology:** We utilize **tunnel freezing technology (Tunnel Freezer)** for rapid
> cooling. This method ensures that the core of the product is frozen quickly, preventing the
> formation of large ice crystals and maintaining optimal cell structure and texture stability.

### 7. Packaging & Quality Assurance

Fries are immediately sealed in protective, labeled packaging. Our standard products typically
contain only potatoes and vegetable oil, upholding a commitment to clean labeling.

[Frozen French Fries Production Process]

## Dinweys Frozen French Fries Production

*We use highly automated production lines, with an average of only 8–10 workers per shift on each
line.
Our production capacity reaches up to **30 tons per day**, with an **annual output of approximately
10,000 tons**.*

isn't the same place your agents can access it.

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and

and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

# Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix

"The Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix (GSI-Matrix) is a premier international intelligence
portal dedicated to specialized manufacturing sectors including textiles, printing, papermaking, and
packaging. As a deep observer of ""System Integration"" capabilities in modern light industry and
infrastructure, GSI-Matrix aims to perfectly link vertical industry know-how with large-scale
production equipment through high-authority intelligence ""stitching.""

Strategic Intelligence Center: The Decision Brain for Vertical Industries. The ""Strategic
Intelligence Center"" at the heart of GSI-Matrix is the platform's soul. Driven by Textile Process
Engineers, Food Safety System Architects, and Industrial Economists, the center not only distributes
Latest Sector News—capturing dynamic adjustments in global pulp raw material fluctuations and food
packaging compliance standards—but also provides in-depth Evolutionary Trends reports. These analyze
color management paths in digital printing, nesting algorithms for automated woodworking machinery,
and the efficiency of brick-making machinery in low-carbon building material production. Our
Commercial Insights module reveals structural demand for basic capacity building and high-efficiency
consumer goods packaging lines in global emerging markets, assisting global distributors in
establishing technical prestige through professional intelligence.

Vision & Mission: Cultivating Industry, Linking Manufacture. The mission of GSI-Matrix is to ensure
that every production line and every process stage maximizes asset returns in the global specialized
industrial value chain through professional intelligence. We are committed to promoting the
intellectualization, modularization, and greening of niche manufacturing sectors, helping
enterprises achieve outstanding international brand influence in the tracks of ""Customized
Production"" and ""Mass Output"" through data-driven intelligence.
Our Slogan: Deep Cultivation in Vertical Lines, Intelligence Driving Manufacture."

# Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix

"The Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix (GSI-Matrix) is a premier international intelligence
portal dedicated to specialized manufacturing sectors including textiles, printing, papermaking, and
packaging. As a deep observer of ""System Integration"" capabilities in modern light industry and
infrastructure, GSI-Matrix aims to perfectly link vertical industry know-how with large-scale
production equipment through high-authority intelligence ""stitching.""

Strategic Intelligence Center: The Decision Brain for Vertical Industries. The ""Strategic
Intelligence Center"" at the heart of GSI-Matrix is the platform's soul. Driven by Textile Process
Engineers, Food Safety System Architects, and Industrial Economists, the center not only distributes
Latest Sector News—capturing dynamic adjustments in global pulp raw material fluctuations and food
packaging compliance standards—but also provides in-depth Evolutionary Trends reports. These analyze
color management paths in digital printing, nesting algorithms for automated woodworking machinery,
and the efficiency of brick-making machinery in low-carbon building material production. Our
Commercial Insights module reveals structural demand for basic capacity building and high-efficiency
consumer goods packaging lines in global emerging markets, assisting global distributors in
establishing technical prestige through professional intelligence.

Vision & Mission: Cultivating Industry, Linking Manufacture. The mission of GSI-Matrix is to ensure
that every production line and every process stage maximizes asset returns in the global specialized
industrial value chain through professional intelligence. We are committed to promoting the
intellectualization, modularization, and greening of niche manufacturing sectors, helping
enterprises achieve outstanding international brand influence in the tracks of ""Customized
Production"" and ""Mass Output"" through data-driven intelligence.
Our Slogan: Deep Cultivation in Vertical Lines, Intelligence Driving Manufacture."

# Reduce the risk of temperature excursions with savENRG® PCM Packs

## **What happens when samples are exposed to extreme temperatures?**
1. **Delay of frozen samples shipped on dry-ice**Packages shipped on dry ice must be marked with a
   hazard label. The carrier generally will apply a dry ice surcharge. Also, most airlines have a
   restriction on how much dry ice is allowed onboard while freighters may carry more than passenger
   aircraft. Improper packaging of samples and restrictions on dry ice loading on airlines can lead
   to samples stranded on the tarmac. This can ultimately result in a delay in providing healthcare
   and increased cost in procuring another sample. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of delay
   of frozen samples shipped on dry ice [Read more…][16]
2. **Freezing of refrigerated and controlled room temperature (CRT) samples**Refrigerated and CRT
   samples can easily damage if frozen. Long exposure to winter ambient temperatures and freezing
   temperatures in airline cargo sections can reduce the temperature of refrigerated samples well
   below freezing. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of freezing samples [Read more…][17]

#### [Ice Packs][18]

Maintain frozen payloads below -20°C (-4°F)

[Read More...][19]

#### [Freezer Packs][20]

Maintain frozen payloads below -5°C (+23°F)

[Read More...][21]

#### [Cool Packs][22]

Maintain refrigerated payloads below +8°C (+46°F)

[Read More...][23]

#### [CRT Packs][24]

Provides freeze protection to CRT loads, maintaining temperature above +15°C (+59°F)

[Read More...][25]

#### [Ambient Packs][26]

Provides overheat protection, maintaining temperature below +25°C (+77°F)

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

## **What products do you supply?**

Fresh & frozen fruits/vegetables and selected legumes. Availability is seasonal; we share a live
availability list and suggested varieties per market.

## **How are prices quoted and how long are they valid?**

Quotes are **FOB/CFR/CIF**, market-linked, and usually valid **24–72 hours** depending on product,
quantity, and vessel space.

## **Which payment terms do you accept?**

**LC at sight, DP, TT (e.g., 30/70)**. Third-party inspection (SGS/BV) and escrow are available upon
request.

## **What is the minimum order?**

One full container (FCL) — 20’ or 40’. Mixed pallets/varieties are possible if temperature/handling
match.

## **What is the lead time from order to shipment?**

Typically **3–7 days** after PI & payment to harvest/pack/QC and load; **fast-track 3–5 days** for
in-stock or frozen items.

## **How do you ensure quality?**

Farm selection, grading, and **pre-shipment QC** with photo/video reports; reefer **PTI/VGM** and
temperature settings shared; SGS/BV optional.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

## **What products do you supply?**

Fresh & frozen fruits/vegetables and selected legumes. Availability is seasonal; we share a live
availability list and suggested varieties per market.

## **How are prices quoted and how long are they valid?**

Quotes are **FOB/CFR/CIF**, market-linked, and usually valid **24–72 hours** depending on product,
quantity, and vessel space.

## **Which payment terms do you accept?**

**LC at sight, DP, TT (e.g., 30/70)**. Third-party inspection (SGS/BV) and escrow are available upon
request.

## **What is the minimum order?**

One full container (FCL) — 20’ or 40’. Mixed pallets/varieties are possible if temperature/handling
match.

## **What is the lead time from order to shipment?**

Typically **3–7 days** after PI & payment to harvest/pack/QC and load; **fast-track 3–5 days** for
in-stock or frozen items.

## **How do you ensure quality?**

Farm selection, grading, and **pre-shipment QC** with photo/video reports; reefer **PTI/VGM** and
temperature settings shared; SGS/BV optional.

### RIPPLEPAK:
### TORONTO COMMERCIAL & RETAIL LEVEL PACKAGING EXPERTS

A division of Uthane Research Ltd, RipplePak Ltd. is a technology-oriented company based in Toronto
that specializes in industrial packaging. The company was established by Mr. Ragui Ghali in 1976
with the objective to develop and to commercialize new technologies in the fields of packaging,
insulation and plastic.

#### Smart Designs, State-Of-The-Art Products

At RipplePak, we believe that our continued success is due to our dedication to provide innovative,
quality packaging and insulation products and professional services to our customers, including:
* [Moving supplies][28]
* [Cold chain solutions][29]
* [Packaging material][30]
* [Insulapack Insulation][31]

When you deal with RipplePak, we make it a point to enhance your products’ quality thanks in part to
the best protection solutions designed for transport and storage. We offer a wide variety of
packaging and shipping products and services that suit a countless number of applications.

**The World of Packaging Supplies in Canada**

RipplePak specializes in industrial packaging and has been around for decades to offer new and
innovative solutions to the process of safely moving products. The company employs the touch of
technology to handle every product’s specific design and needs expertly. It was founded by a
chemical engineer whose expert knowledge of thermodynamics allowed him to come up with innovative
methods of using the right raw materials for the most effective packaging solutions.

When moving items, the primary goal becomes its safe arrival to its destination. Often, even the
most well-packed item can end up in pieces. Professional Packing Companies in Toronto work to ensure
this is avoided by offering services that include packaging supplies in Canada. Whether the packed
product will be shipped or stored, packing manufacturers offer every solution, from industrial
packing supplies to cold chain solutions.

**Custom Packaging**

Custom packaging manufacturing companies offer solutions that help companies or individuals refer to
a wide variety of styles, shapes, and packaging designs. Custom package manufacturing companies
allow an individual or company to choose the kind of impression they would like their packaging to
make. After all, before the product inside is revealed, the package makes the first impressions, and
first impressions are thought to be the last impressions for a reason. Custom package manufacturing
companies give way for individuality and creativity without sacrificing effectiveness and
functionality.

Technology has allowed for a great number of innovative ways of packaging, including:
* [Bubble Wrap][32]
* [Pabble Wrap][33]
* [Die-Cut Foam Packaging][34]
* [Corrugated U-Channels][35]
* [Extra Heavy Duty Pabble Wrap][36]
* [Corners and End Caps][37]

Each offers its unique look, but most importantly, it promises varying ways and degrees of security
depending on the product being packaged. It’s all about understanding the product that is being
packaged.

## Your Questions About Our Factory & Products, Answered

Transparency is key. Here are answers to common questions from our global partners.

#### Are you a direct manufacturer or a trading company?

We are a direct manufacturer (Factory). Romi Industry evolved from a catering business into a
full-scale manufacturing facility. We invite you to visit our production lines in Dongguan.

#### Can I get samples before placing a bulk order?

Yes! We offer Free Samples so you can test the quality, size, and durability yourself. You only need
to cover the shipping cost.

#### What is your MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)?

We are start-up friendly. While MOQs vary by product (e.g., custom print vs. stock), we strive to
offer lower entry thresholds than the industry average to help you grow.

#### Do your products have food safety certifications?

Absolutely. All our products, including Corn Starch, PP, and flexible pouches, are certified to meet
FDA and LFGB standards for food safety.

#### Can you help with the design of my packaging?

Yes, we have an in-house design team. Whether you need a logo on a cup or a full layout for a coffee
bag, we provide design support from concept to print.

#### What makes your 'Stone-Powder Box' better than cardboard?

Unlike cardboard which absorbs water and collapses, our Stone-Powder + PP composite is 100%
waterproof, crush-resistant, and freezable. It's lighter than plastic crates but tougher than paper.

Our story

## The operationbehind the box.

When you call us about a new lane, a custom pack out, or a tighter temperature window, you’re
talking to the people who’ll build it. TempAid is built on a decades-long thermal manufacturing
operation that already had the plants, the engineering, and the production teams in place.

Founder-led, with short decision lines and a team that picks up the same day you call. Six
wholly-owned facilities across four countries producing twenty million units a month, and our own
ISTA-Certified Lab qualifies each shipment before the file ships with the order.

Specialty pharmacies, compounding pharmacies, and the teams who deliver to patients directly. That’s
who we built this for.

[Our story][26]
Who we serve

## Every sector has adifferent audit to pass.

Every industry has its own compliance cycle, accreditation window, and documentation requirements.

Specialty pharmacy

### Specialty pharmacy

Specialty pharma runs on precision: cold chain, compliance, and storage that earns its space.
TempAid is built around those same realities. Our pack outs meet your accreditation requirements,
hold 2–8°C and CRT ranges across the toughest lanes, and ship qualified for direct-to-patient
biologics and cell and gene therapy. Whether you’re managing chronic specialty fills or one-off
high-value shipments, the documentation lands with the order. Ready for your auditor, your finance
team, and the patient on the other end.

[Learn more][27]

02

Pharma manufacturing

### Pharma manufacturing

Pharma manufacturing moves across borders, stages, and temperature ranges that change order to
order. TempAid is built for that. Our pack outs are qualified to USP <1079> and Good Distribution
Practice standards, tested in our ISTA-certified lab, and meet Health Canada, FDA, and EU GMP
distribution expectations. We hold frozen and deep-frozen ranges across global lanes, from bulk API
moves to finished goods to clinical trial logistics. Whether you’re shipping commercial inventory or
trial supplies, our pack outs deliver the qualification rigor your QA team, your auditors, and your
supply chain leadership can all stand behind.

[Learn more][28]

03

Healthcare distribution

### Healthcare distribution

margins. Every shipment has to clear both. TempAid is built for that. USP <1079> and GDP-aligned
pack outs. ISTA-qualified for the lanes you run. Compliant with Health Canada, FDA, and EU GMP, at a
total cost of ownership built for distribution economics. We hold 2–8°C, CRT, frozen, and
deep-frozen ranges across every client in your book, while reducing material spend, dimensional
weight, and warehouse footprint. Compliance you can prove to your manufacturer clients. Economics
your CFO can sign off on.

[Learn more][29]

Clinical and biotech

hold 2–8°C and CRT ranges across the toughest lanes, and ship qualified for direct-to-patient
biologics and cell and gene therapy. Whether you’re managing chronic specialty fills or one-off
high-value shipments, the documentation lands with the order. Ready for your auditor, your finance
team, and the patient on the other end.

[Learn more][27]

02

Pharma manufacturing

### Pharma manufacturing

Pharma manufacturing moves across borders, stages, and temperature ranges that change order to
order. TempAid is built for that. Our pack outs are qualified to USP <1079> and Good Distribution
Practice standards, tested in our ISTA-certified lab, and meet Health Canada, FDA, and EU GMP
distribution expectations. We hold frozen and deep-frozen ranges across global lanes, from bulk API
moves to finished goods to clinical trial logistics. Whether you’re shipping commercial inventory or
trial supplies, our pack outs deliver the qualification rigor your QA team, your auditors, and your
supply chain leadership can all stand behind.

[Learn more][28]

03

Healthcare distribution

### Healthcare distribution

Healthcare distribution carries manufacturer-level regulatory expectations on distribution-level
margins. Every shipment has to clear both. TempAid is built for that. USP <1079> and GDP-aligned
pack outs. ISTA-qualified for the lanes you run. Compliant with Health Canada, FDA, and EU GMP, at a
total cost of ownership built for distribution economics. We hold 2–8°C, CRT, frozen, and
deep-frozen ranges across every client in your book, while reducing material spend, dimensional
weight, and warehouse footprint. Compliance you can prove to your manufacturer clients. Economics
your CFO can sign off on.

[Learn more][29]

04

Clinical and biotech

### Clinical and biotech

Clinical trials and biotech move material that exists in single quantities: cell lines, patient
samples, investigational therapies. Each one arrives once. TempAid is built for that. Our pack outs
comply with GCP, GMP, and GDP standards, are qualified through ISTA-aligned testing protocols, and
meet Health Canada, FDA, EMA, and ICH distribution expectations across direct-to-site and
direct-to-patient lanes. We hold 2–8°C, CRT, frozen, and deep-frozen ranges for investigational
medicinal products, cell and gene therapies, biologics, and patient samples across global climates
and unpredictable trial logistics. Whether you’re enrolling first-in-human or scaling to Phase III,
our pack outs protect your product, your patients, and the data the trial depends on.

[Learn more][30]

05

3PL and logistics

### 3PL and logistics

3PLs and pharma logistics handle product you don’t own, for clients who audit every shipment. Every
client holds you to their own qualification standards and the regulatory frameworks their business
runs on. TempAid is built to meet you there. Pack outs designed to meet your clients’ regulatory
requirements, backed by the qualification reports your clients require. ISTA-aligned testing across
road, air, ocean, and last-mile. Holding 2–8°C, CRT, frozen, and deep-frozen ranges from origin to
destination, so the end-to-end temperature control your clients expect is delivered on every
shipment in your network. Cost discipline your operations team runs on.

[Learn more][31]

Compounding pharmacy

### Compounding pharmacy

503A compounding doesn’t have room for error. Every prescription is patient-specific, every
formulation is unique, and every shipment carries a beyond-use date that depends on staying in spec
from your hood to the patient’s door. TempAid is built for that. Our pack outs are designed to meet
USP <797>, <795>, and <800> distribution expectations, qualified through ISTA-aligned testing
protocols, and aligned with state board of pharmacy requirements. We hold 2–8°C, CRT, and frozen
ranges for sterile and non-sterile compounds, oncology IVs, TPN, hormone preparations, and the full
range of patient-specific therapies your pharmacy ships. Whether you’re delivering to clinics,
infusion centers, or directly to patients at home, our pack outs protect the BUD, the patient, and
the documentation your state inspector will ask for.

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

Map labels © [OpenStreetMap][25] contributors.

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.

## Optimize your cold chain management for last-mile home delivery with Tempack

Tempack’s passive temperature-controlled solutions are specifically developed to support **food
last-mile delivery operations**, ensuring that chilled and frozen products maintain stability from
fulfilment preparation through to final distribution.
Our systems help retailers, e-grocery operators and logistics providers preserve product quality
while improving operational efficiency in urban delivery environments.

**Preservation of Freshness and Quality**

Our packaging maintains the precise temperature ranges required for chilled and frozen food
distribution, preventing spoilage and preserving product quality throughout last-mile delivery
routes.

**Guaranteed Cold Chain Integrity**

Designed specifically for last-mile deliveries, our packaging solutions maintain stable temperatures
even in varying external conditions, ensuring cold chain integrity from the distribution or
fulfilment centre to the customer.

**Reduced Spoilage and Waste**

By protecting chilled and frozen products during home delivery, our solutions minimize product loss,
reducing waste and supporting both sustainability efforts and cost savings for retailers.

**Compliance with Home Delivery Standards**

All packaging solutions are built to meet the necessary regulations and best practices for
transporting perishable goods, ensuring compliance and reducing the risk of product returns or
customer dissatisfaction upon delivery.

**Traceability and monitoring**

Our packaging solutions can integrate monitoring technologies to provide visibility across food
distribution routes, suporting quality assurance and operational control in last-mile
delivery.  Depending on operational needs, features may include temperature alerts, location
visibility and connectivity tools that help logistics teams maintain product integrity throughout

plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries

What services does CLEARFAST offer?

*CLEARFAST provides comprehensive logistics solutions including air and sea freight forwarding,
custom clearance, warehousing, transportation management, supply chain consultancy, and specialized
services for handling over-dimensional cargo, temperature-sensitive goods, and dangerous goods. Our
global network ensures your cargo reaches its destination efficiently and safely*

How does CLEARFAST ensure timely delivery of cargo?

solutions across our global network.*

Can CLEARFAST handle the logistics for specialized cargo?

# Specialists in Temperature Controlled Logistics

Reliable cold chain solutions for food and pharmaceutical shipments across the UK, Europe, and
worldwide.

[Speak to an Expert][13]
[Get a Quote][14]

Welcome to Cool Cargo UK — your trusted specialist in cold chain logistics.


We provide temperature‑controlled transport solutions for chilled, frozen, and ambient goods,
ensuring your food and pharmaceutical shipments are delivered safely, compliantly, and on time.


With services by air, road, and sea, Cool Cargo supports UK‑to‑EU and global shipments with full
temperature control, live tracking, and expert handling.

### Our Cold Chain Services

#### Temperature Controlled Air Freight

[temperature-controlled air cargo]

Chilled and frozen air cargo solutions for urgent and time critical food and pharmaceutical
shipments.

#### Refrigerated Road Transport

[Refrigerated-Transport-uk-cool-cargo-EU (2).jpg]

UK and European chilled and frozen groupage and full load services with monitored temperature
control.

#### Reefer Sea Freight Shipping

[shipping services.jpg]

Cost effective refrigerated container shipping for frozen and chilled goods worldwide.

#### Pharmaceutical & Sample Couriers

[Pharmaceutical Transport UK.jpg]

Dedicated temperature controlled courier services for medicines, trials, and time sensitive samples.

## Interdisciplinary
## Brand & Design Innovation Consultancy

[See All Solutions][29]

As an interdisciplinary brand and design innovation consultancy, Creativeans bridges strategy,
creativity, business thinking, and technology to help organisations build brands that matter. We
believe that strong brands are not built through design alone, but through a deep understanding of
the business, its people, market opportunities, customer needs, and long-term growth ambitions.

Guided by our proprietary methodologies such as [**BrandBuilder^{®}**][30] and [**EDIT Design
Thinking^{®}**][31], we work across brand strategy, identity design, packaging, UI/UX,
communication, and experience design to create solutions that are both meaningful and actionable.
Our approach allows us to uncover insights, define clear brand directions, and translate strategy
into tangible touchpoints that connect with audiences across every stage of the brand journey.

Branding

There’s a direct connection between a company’s brand and its success. A strong brand provides a
significant competitive advantage that differentiates it from its competitors.

As brand builders, we combine strategic and creative thinking to offer an integrated and holistic
approach to increase brand value. We help to audit and position your brand, express your brand
identity and eventually, execute your brand touch points. In other words, the whole nine yards. We
leave nothing to chance.

The success of a business’s brand goes hand in hand with continuous innovation. Through our
interdisciplinary use of analytical tools and creative processes, we help businesses uncover and
take advantage of untapped opportunities in the market and transform their business.

# **Dinweys Frozen French Fries** **Factory（Hebei, China)**
* **Dinweys** offers a diverse range of cuts and sizes (Shoestring, Crinkle, Straight Cut) with

[China french fries factory]

## Frozen French Fries Production Process

The meticulous control over each stage ensures the superior quality and frying performance of
Dinweys’ frozen French fries. Our process is optimized for high dry matter retention, texture
consistency, and long-term stability.

### 1. Raw Material Selection: The Foundation of Quality

We begin with high-quality potatoes selected specifically for processing.

> **Key Advantage:** We exclusively use potato raw materials with a **dry matter content exceeding
> 22% (DM）> 22%)**. This crucial factor ensures a lower oil absorption rate and a crispier final
> texture.

### 2. High-Efficiency Cleaning & Peeling

Raw potatoes undergo thorough cleaning followed by a precise, hygienic peeling process.

> **Key Technique:** Peeling is performed using **high-temperature steam**, which minimizes surface
> damage and retains more of the potato’s valuable outer layer nutrients compared to mechanical
> abrasive methods.

### 3. Precision Cutting & Water Reduction

Potatoes are cut into uniform strips (e.g., standard 9mm or 12mm) using high-precision cutters.
Ripple-cut styles are also available.

> **Crucial Step (Dewatering):** Following blanching, we achieve a high **product dehydration rate
> of 25%–30%**. This optimized moisture removal is vital for minimizing oil absorption during frying
> and maximizing final crispiness.

### 4. Blanching & Color Protection

Strips are blanched at controlled temperatures (85–95°C) to remove excess starch and lock in color.

### 5. Pre-Frying (Par-Frying)

The fries are par-fried at approximately 160°C to develop the iconic golden color and form a
protective outer layer, enhancing flavor and crunch when cooked by the end-user.

### 6. Advanced Quick Freezing

Rapid freezing is critical for locking in flavor and texture.

> **Advanced Technology:** We utilize **tunnel freezing technology (Tunnel Freezer)** for rapid
> cooling. This method ensures that the core of the product is frozen quickly, preventing the
> formation of large ice crystals and maintaining optimal cell structure and texture stability.

### 7. Packaging & Quality Assurance

Fries are immediately sealed in protective, labeled packaging. Our standard products typically
contain only potatoes and vegetable oil, upholding a commitment to clean labeling.

[Frozen French Fries Production Process]

## Dinweys Frozen French Fries Production

*We use highly automated production lines, with an average of only 8–10 workers per shift on each
line.
Our production capacity reaches up to **30 tons per day**, with an **annual output of approximately
10,000 tons**.*

## AWARD WINNING DESIGN

Global Cold Chain Solutions has been awarded the 2022 Australian Enterprise Award for Best
Temperature-Controlled Supply Chain Solutions and the Distinction Award for Contributions to
Pandemic Relief.

## Global Supplier

GCCS has offices and warehouses in Australia, India, Germany and Malaysia. We supply global
companies with temperature packaging solutions.

## GMP Qualified

GCCS offers GDP and GMP qualified packaging solutions.

# Home

## **Global Cold Chain Solutions are specialists in GDP temperature controlled packaging and
## temperature monitoring for pharmaceuticals, healthcare and logistics. **

Global Cold Chain Solutions (GCCS) is an approved one-stop-provider of cold chain solutions focusing
on the requirements of the pharmaceutical and pharma logistics industry. Due to our global presence
we are close to our customers supporting their need for stable supply chains. Our highly flexible
GMP and GDP certified production concept allows for offering tailor-made solutions, thoroughly
tested, documented and taking into account optimising the cost of our customer‘s warehousing and
transportation.

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Courier Shipper Icon]

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Calibration Icon]

**[CALIBRATION SERVICES][18]**

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Qualification Icon]

**[QUALIFICATION SERVICES][19]**

[Transport Icon]

**[GMP TRANSPORT SOLUTIONS][20]**

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Innovation Icon]

**[INNOVATIONS][21]**

**OUR STORY**

Since 2003, *Global Cold Chain Solutions (GCCS) have specialised in GMP/GDP temperature packaging
design and GMP qualified temperature supply chain solutions. We have designed and qualified more
than 400 different models’ sizes and temperature ranges of pallets and shippers. We are proud to be
[delivering customised COVID-19 vaccine shipping solutions][22] from all our factories approved by
WHO and UNICEF for shipments into developing countries. *

*GGCS is continuously developing new and innovative solutions. Our current projects including active
solutions last mile, last 100 metres and critical care medical travel bags to allow patients to
travel with their medicines safely with them. Our pharmaceutical solutions include monitoring
medicine in patients’ fridges to ensure they consume their medicine daily and end-to-end [clinical
trial solutions][23].*

*Our speciality is customising designs to meet exact client requirements and more than 60% of our
manufacturing shippers are customised models. Our unique modular manufacturing enables us to be the
only company who can manufacture shippers from every known insulation material at every site
globally. We are one of only three cold chain packaging companies globally who manufactures their
own Phase Change Materials (PCM) and the only company who manufacturers PCM’s at every manufacturing
site. GCCS has the largest [packaging and environment testing][24] laboratory in Asia-Pacific with
five temperature chambers, compression testing, vibration and drop testing. Our testing facilities
include calibration, phase change material R&D and DSC testing.*

Global Cold Chain Solutions specialises in GDP and GMP compliant temperature-sensitive products and
services for the pharmaceutical, healthcare, bio-tech, exporters, clinical trial and logistics
industries in Australia, Asia Pacific, Germany and India. Certified [AS/NZS ISO 9001-2016][25], GCCS
team has a quality and customer-service focus to ensure temperature-sensitive products maintain
their integrity at all times during storage and distribution. GCCS products & services are of the
highest standard & quality. **Our validations meet GMP, GDP, CFR 21, WHO, MHRA, FDA and HACCP
compliances.** To learn more about our products and services, please [contact us][26].

## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.

compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

standards demand documented, auditable proof that products stayed within safe temperature ranges —

# Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix

"The Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix (GSI-Matrix) is a premier international intelligence
portal dedicated to specialized manufacturing sectors including textiles, printing, papermaking, and
packaging. As a deep observer of ""System Integration"" capabilities in modern light industry and
infrastructure, GSI-Matrix aims to perfectly link vertical industry know-how with large-scale
production equipment through high-authority intelligence ""stitching.""

Strategic Intelligence Center: The Decision Brain for Vertical Industries. The ""Strategic
Intelligence Center"" at the heart of GSI-Matrix is the platform's soul. Driven by Textile Process
Engineers, Food Safety System Architects, and Industrial Economists, the center not only distributes
Latest Sector News—capturing dynamic adjustments in global pulp raw material fluctuations and food
packaging compliance standards—but also provides in-depth Evolutionary Trends reports. These analyze
color management paths in digital printing, nesting algorithms for automated woodworking machinery,
and the efficiency of brick-making machinery in low-carbon building material production. Our
Commercial Insights module reveals structural demand for basic capacity building and high-efficiency
consumer goods packaging lines in global emerging markets, assisting global distributors in
establishing technical prestige through professional intelligence.

Vision & Mission: Cultivating Industry, Linking Manufacture. The mission of GSI-Matrix is to ensure
that every production line and every process stage maximizes asset returns in the global specialized
industrial value chain through professional intelligence. We are committed to promoting the
intellectualization, modularization, and greening of niche manufacturing sectors, helping
enterprises achieve outstanding international brand influence in the tracks of ""Customized
Production"" and ""Mass Output"" through data-driven intelligence.
Our Slogan: Deep Cultivation in Vertical Lines, Intelligence Driving Manufacture."

Manufacturer for **savENRG® PCM Packs**, a sustainable series of phase change material based cold
chain refrigerants.

Protect your diagnostic and clinical trial samples from the risks of temperature excursion by
transporting them with **savENRG® PCM Packs**, a sustainable series of phase change material-based
cold chain refrigerants.

[home banner]

# Reduce the risk of temperature excursions with savENRG® PCM Packs

## **What happens when samples are exposed to extreme temperatures?**
1. **Delay of frozen samples shipped on dry-ice**Packages shipped on dry ice must be marked with a
   hazard label. The carrier generally will apply a dry ice surcharge. Also, most airlines have a
   restriction on how much dry ice is allowed onboard while freighters may carry more than passenger
   aircraft. Improper packaging of samples and restrictions on dry ice loading on airlines can lead
   to samples stranded on the tarmac. This can ultimately result in a delay in providing healthcare
   and increased cost in procuring another sample. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of delay
   of frozen samples shipped on dry ice [Read more…][16]
2. **Freezing of refrigerated and controlled room temperature (CRT) samples**Refrigerated and CRT
   samples can easily damage if frozen. Long exposure to winter ambient temperatures and freezing
   temperatures in airline cargo sections can reduce the temperature of refrigerated samples well
   below freezing. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of freezing samples [Read more…][17]

#### [Ice Packs][18]

Maintain frozen payloads below -20°C (-4°F)

[Read More...][19]

#### [Freezer Packs][20]

Maintain frozen payloads below -5°C (+23°F)

[Read More...][21]

#### [Cool Packs][22]

Maintain refrigerated payloads below +8°C (+46°F)

[Read More...][23]

#### [CRT Packs][24]

Provides freeze protection to CRT loads, maintaining temperature above +15°C (+59°F)

[Read More...][25]

#### [Ambient Packs][26]

Provides overheat protection, maintaining temperature below +25°C (+77°F)

[Read More...][27]

   to samples stranded on the tarmac. This can ultimately result in a delay in providing healthcare
   and increased cost in procuring another sample. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of delay
   of frozen samples shipped on dry ice [Read more…][16]
2. **Freezing of refrigerated and controlled room temperature (CRT) samples**Refrigerated and CRT
   samples can easily damage if frozen. Long exposure to winter ambient temperatures and freezing
   temperatures in airline cargo sections can reduce the temperature of refrigerated samples well
   below freezing. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of freezing samples [Read more…][17]

# **Welcome to Reefer Express**

Reefer Express is a leading cold chain logistics solution company that offers integrated storage and
logistics solutions for temperature-controlled supply chains. We have best-in-class technology with
vehicle tracking, GPS services as well professional experience in the field of supply chain
management to ensure the safe delivery of products from farms all over India into cities where
they’re needed most!

Our business objective is to provide our customers with the best possible experience by offering an
efficient solution, competitive prices, and outstanding service. Whether you are entering a new
market, need a leaner supply chain, predictable costs, operational transparency, or a storage
solution – we have got you covered.

[reefer express]

offer a complete range of services, from product storage and transportation to distribution and
delivery.

[logistic]

We offer a temperature-controlled logistics service that helps to ensure your perishables remain

[Learn More][72]

Cold chain packaging for the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. We offer a complete portfolio of

temperature-sensitive medical supplies and equipment.

It carries the compliance, documentation, and audit trail that keep your accreditation current. We
test your pack out in our own lab, qualify it for the lanes it actually travels, and ship the file
ready ahead of your next audit.

Our story

## The operationbehind the box.

When you call us about a new lane, a custom pack out, or a tighter temperature window, you’re
talking to the people who’ll build it. TempAid is built on a decades-long thermal manufacturing
operation that already had the plants, the engineering, and the production teams in place.

Founder-led, with short decision lines and a team that picks up the same day you call. Six
wholly-owned facilities across four countries producing twenty million units a month, and our own
ISTA-Certified Lab qualifies each shipment before the file ships with the order.

Specialty pharmacies, compounding pharmacies, and the teams who deliver to patients directly. That’s
who we built this for.

[Our story][26]
Who we serve

## Every sector has adifferent audit to pass.

Every industry has its own compliance cycle, accreditation window, and documentation requirements.
We learn yours, and we build around it.

01

Specialty pharmacy

### Specialty pharmacy

Specialty pharma runs on precision: cold chain, compliance, and storage that earns its space.
TempAid is built around those same realities. Our pack outs meet your accreditation requirements,
hold 2–8°C and CRT ranges across the toughest lanes, and ship qualified for direct-to-patient
biologics and cell and gene therapy. Whether you’re managing chronic specialty fills or one-off
high-value shipments, the documentation lands with the order. Ready for your auditor, your finance
team, and the patient on the other end.

[Learn more][27]

02

Pharma manufacturing

### Pharma manufacturing

Pharma manufacturing moves across borders, stages, and temperature ranges that change order to
order. TempAid is built for that. Our pack outs are qualified to USP <1079> and Good Distribution
Practice standards, tested in our ISTA-certified lab, and meet Health Canada, FDA, and EU GMP
distribution expectations. We hold frozen and deep-frozen ranges across global lanes, from bulk API
moves to finished goods to clinical trial logistics. Whether you’re shipping commercial inventory or
trial supplies, our pack outs deliver the qualification rigor your QA team, your auditors, and your
supply chain leadership can all stand behind.

[Learn more][28]

03

Healthcare distribution

### Healthcare distribution

margins. Every shipment has to clear both. TempAid is built for that. USP <1079> and GDP-aligned
pack outs. ISTA-qualified for the lanes you run. Compliant with Health Canada, FDA, and EU GMP, at a
total cost of ownership built for distribution economics. We hold 2–8°C, CRT, frozen, and
deep-frozen ranges across every client in your book, while reducing material spend, dimensional
weight, and warehouse footprint. Compliance you can prove to your manufacturer clients. Economics
your CFO can sign off on.

[Learn more][29]

04

direct-to-patient lanes. We hold 2–8°C, CRT, frozen, and deep-frozen ranges for investigational

margins. Every shipment has to clear both. TempAid is built for that. USP <1079> and GDP-aligned

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

Map labels © [OpenStreetMap][25] contributors.

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.
